notes: Local raw-input fixture for Phase 2E. This is an offline sample for converter validation only; it is not scraped, fetched, or used by the app runtime.

identityName.rationale: The reviewed source supports the Grillpoint Deli display-name claim for review evidence.

categoryBusinessType.rationale: The current evidence can support review-only deli/food-retail categorization, but the raw claims do not yet isolate a product-copy category assertion.
categoryBusinessType.neededEvidence: A reviewed source claim or approved manual review row that explicitly supports the category/business-type copy field.

addressLocation.rationale: The reviewed source supports the address text used in review-card context.

storefrontFacade.rationale: The current evidence does not support exact storefront, sign, facade, or visual translation claims.
storefrontFacade.neededEvidence: Owned/approved facade reference plus reviewed source notes separating stylized visual treatment from exact facade claims.

entranceFrontageGeometry.rationale: The current evidence does not support exact entrance, frontage, address-placement, parcel, or building-footprint geometry.
entranceFrontageGeometry.neededEvidence: Reviewed parcel/building/frontage/entrance evidence or an approved manual geometry review row.

confidence.rationale: Supports review-card identity, category, and address context; does not support exact frontage, facade, or entrance placement.

claims.notes: Used only for review-card identity; not a production business-record claim.
Supports address text in the selected card, not exact raster address placement.

qaNotes: Secondary source remains restricted to review-only factual card copy.
No ratings, reviews, hours, delivery, ownership, popularity, quality, or promotional claims are used.
remainingGaps: Exact storefront frontage, sign geometry, entrance position, and address placement remain approximate.
Parcel/tax-lot and building-footprint geometry remain unresolved for this MVP slice.
